$comment: Read by the risk-gate workflow and `scripts/agent` (docs/GITHUB.md, Merging and the risk gate). A PR is HIGH risk if a changed file matches high.paths, a path under keywordScope has a high.keywords segment, a migration changes an existing file or has destructive SQL, a contract has a breaking change, or it has a high.labels label: it merges only with human:merge-ok or a human merge. MEDIUM risk (medium.paths, medium.keywords, new additive migrations, additive contract changes) merges after an approving review by a different agent session than the author's. Everything else is LOW risk and merges after any approving agent review. autoMerge: scripts/agent pr turns on auto-merge, but only once the default branch requires every check in requiredChecks. Changes to this file are themselves high risk.

approval.$comment: Approved documents approve scope: while every file in documents has Status Approved, scripts/agent approves a task that uses only approved features of one journey, in the milestone ROADMAP.md gives that journey, passes the definition-of-ready check and whose journey plan has no open questions. Platform work and anything else still needs scripts/agent approve-journey.
